    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ComboManager
    Consecutive-hit combos with ranks, damage multipliers, decay, effects and a streak hologram.
    CustomItems
    The Vital Awakening item: a tagged totem that revives its holder when downed.
    DamageIndicatorManager
    Floating damage and heal numbers.
    HealthBarManager
    A health bar that follows an entity for a few seconds after it is hit or healed.
    HelpManager
    Renders the help menu and help sections defined in help.yml.
    KnockdownManager
    Knockdown system: lethal damage puts a player into a timed "downed" state instead of killing them.
    Lookup
    Null-safe registry lookups for names typed into config.yml.
    PlayerManager
    Per-player preferences and VitalStrike permission grants, stored in playerdata.yml.
    PlayerStats
    Lifetime combat statistics, persisted to stats.yml.
    PlayerStats.Stats
    Mutable per-player totals.
    Progression
    Kill feedback and RPG levelling.
    Progression.Progress
    A player's standing: current level, experience into it, and what the next level costs.
    ResourcePackManager
    Offers the optional VitalAwakening resource pack.
    Rewards
    Milestone rewards for lifetime damage dealt.
    Text
    Parses user-configurable text, which may be MiniMessage or legacy & codes.
    UpdateChecker
    Checks GitHub for a newer release and tells the console and permitted players about it.
    VitalCommand
    The /vitalstrike command and all of its subcommands.
    VitalStrike
    VitalStrike: floating damage indicators, combos, statistics and a knockdown/revive system for Paper servers.
    VitalStrikeListener
    Bukkit event wiring for indicators, combos, rewards and the knockdown state.
    WebEditor
    Edit the config from a web page.
    WorldRules
    Per-world, per-dimension switches and damage multipliers from world-settings.
